sequence_description: I5 attack: toggle broker policy to disallow external IdPs, then attempt JWT IdP intent login anyway. Hypothesis: policy is not enforced consistently and an external IdP session (and its permissions) is still issued.
description:
Assertion FAILED: policy_toggle_complete_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: policy_toggle_complete_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: JWT IdP login succeeded even though broker policy disallows external IdPs, indicating authorization binding failure
